header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Muhammad Sharif Solangi, A.A.G a/w Mr. Afraz Saeed
body: Assistant Commissioner Sindhri and Mr. Arsalan Akhund Assistant Executive Engineer on behalf of X.E.N Thar Division.
Learned A.A.G has filed parawise comments of Assistant Commissioner, Sindhri (respondent No.12), which are taken on record.

The only grievance of the petitioner is that to direct the respondents to construct a bridge over Girhore @ Samaro Shakh for the betterment of the villagers. While disposing of instant petition we direct the Deputy Commissioner, Mirpurkhas, to hear the petitioner and redress his grievance in accordance with law within 60 days.
Copy of this order be communicated to the Deputy Commissioner, Mirpurkhas, for compliance.
